decisions.reason: Operator training draws directly on the firm's application know-how and training capabilities, and its own page in both 2018 and 2019 shows a stable offer the firm can readily interpret and improve.
A fourth rotary axis is a modular accessory built on the firm's machine expertise and complements its milling systems, though it was only mentioned on the website.

Hybrid additive post-processing lies far from the firm's existing knowledge base, limits its ability to read early results and learn from them, and had only a minor web presence, so resources are better returned to core milling and dental development.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is the firm's core competence, is supported by in-house R&D and testing, and was presented on its own page.
The automatic tool change system builds on established machine and tooling know-how, adds productivity to the firm's systems, and was featured on a dedicated page.
